summary: StorageAuthBase — pydantic-settings mixin providing shared configuration fields across all provider settings classes: TIMEOUT, ROOT_PATH, CREATE_PATH, USERNAME, PASSWORD, and others. Inherited by all concrete provider settings classes (S3Settings, AzureStorageSettings, etc.).
extension_points: New shared fields should be added here rather than to individual provider classes
documentation_hooks: Fields on StorageAuthBase apply to all providers — document the universal configuration surface here
